cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Non-core property assets are saleable in principle but Mainland property disposal cycle, tax, valuation and liquidity risks are high; book value used, not higher disclosed fair value.

cash_breakdown.reason: Although ordinary operating leases are also reflected in profit quality, the balance-sheet liability is small and explicit.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserved roughly 1.8 months of 2023 revenue and covers inventory/direct retail ramp, franchisee fulfillment and working-capital volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash retained to keep licensing/distribution business running; not detachable.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Additional reserve for Mainland remittance, dividend withholding, exchange and transaction friction not fully quantified in annual report.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deducted after asset haircuts to avoid treating gross Mainland cash/property as immediately distributable.

profit_quality.assessment: 2023 and 2022 operating cash flow exceeded reported profit and capex was low, supporting cash conversion. The denominator is still discounted because the 2023 profit base includes interest/treasury income and investment-property economics, top-five customers contributed about 84% of revenue, and the post-transformation operating model has limited multi-year evidence.
adjustments: Use the 2021-2023 median parent profit of RMB43.166m as normal profit base rather than the best/recent year.
Deduct 2023 capital expenditure of RMB2.475m as maintenance/reinvestment proxy.
Apply 0.75 profit haircut for customer concentration, partial reliance on rental/treasury income and limited post-transformation history.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 OCF RMB115.892m versus parent net profit RMB62.435m; 2022 OCF RMB120.307m versus parent net profit RMB37.136m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash conversion is strong, but sustainability of the post-transformation licensing/distribution profit stream is not proven over three full years and non-shoe/rental/treasury items are meaningful.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Strong in 2022-2023, with operating cash flow above profit.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2023 capex was RMB2.475m; no material capital commitments were disclosed.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 working-capital movements were favorable overall; no additional reinvestment deduction beyond the operating-cash reserve was applied.
